newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM still to decide on cargo rate hike.
newsitem.headline: KLM still to decide on cargo rate hike.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV said Wednesday that it is still considering raising cargo rates in the wake of rising fuel costs.
KLM Cargo spokesman, Maurits Kaalf, said the Dutch airline had still not decided and that discussions were still taking place.
He would only comment that "he hoped to have more news soon". However, he would not give an exact date.
On October 1, KLM said it was considering raising prices after a month of high oil prices. The Amsterdam-based airline is also yet to decide on any passenger fare increases.

Earlier Wednesday British Airways announced a 2.5 percent rise in its European passenger fares following a 30 percent increase in fuel prices since July. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
